title: Testing and Evaluation of Large Language Models: Correctness, Non-Toxicity, and Fairness
reasoning: The thesis contains dedicated frameworks and benchmarks for evaluating LLMs on religious bias, ethics, and morality. Chapter 7 includes 'Religion' and 'Morality' as core evaluation categories, and Chapter 8 explicitly benchmarks LLM 'opinions' using the World Values Survey, which covers traditional religious values versus secular-rational ones, including specific questions on the importance of God and religious faith.
